title: WPSS/3981/2018 of REKHA RAMOLA Vs UNION OF INDIA

paras.text:
WPSS No. 3981 of 2018
Honíble Lok Pal Singh, J.
Mr. Piyush Garg, Advocate for the
petitioner.
Ms. Pushpa Bhatt, Standing counsel
for Union of India.
Mr. Shashank Upadhyaya, Advocate
for respondent no. 3.
Mr. V.S. Rawat, Brief Holder for
respondent no. 4.
Petitioner has filed present writ
petition seeking writ of mandamus directing
respondent no. 3 to include the name of the
petitioner and to permit her to undergo six
months bridge course (PDPET) at
Government Higher Secondary School,
Bheemawala, Vikasnagar, Distict Dehradun.
At the admission stage, the Co-ordinate Bench did not find favour to the
petitioner and it was observed that in view of
clause 2.0 of the scheme the candidate who
participates in the scheme should have at
least 75% of attendance, in absence of
which he or she would not be permitted to
take sessions examination.
Learned counsel for the respondents
would submit that the course in which
petitioner wants to be permitted to
participate in the scheme is over.
To this learned counsel for the
petitioner would submit that the
respondents may be directed that they shall
not deny the petitioner to participate in the
aforesaid course in future.
Learned counsel for the respondents
has no objection to it.
In view of the above, the writ petition
stands disposed of with the direction to the
respondents that in future, if the course is
continue, they shall not deny the petitioner
to participate in the same.
(Lok Pal Singh, J.)
Parul 04.11.2019
